assessment.summary: This study uses transgenic Anopheles gambiae strains to functionally validate the synergistic effects of metabolic resistance (overexpression of P450s, GSTs, and transporters) and target-site resistance (kdr L995F) on insecticide resistance levels. It does not analyze field-collected mosquito populations.
exclusion_reasons: No field-collected mosquito populations were analyzed; the study uses transgenic laboratory strains.
No extractable genotype data from field populations is reported.
